post.description: Files a correction report on the artist's About for an admin to review; any signed-in user may send one. `expectedBio` is the About text the caller read, so a report never lands on an About that has since changed. The same report sent again is acknowledged as a duplicate, and an account may file at most 10 reports in a rolling 24 hours.

details.description: What should change, in the reporter's words. Optional; trimmed.

sourceUrl.description: A public web page that backs the report. Optional; a bare domain gets `https://`. Private or local addresses are refused.

expectedBio.description: The About text the reporter saw, exactly as the read endpoint returned it.

post.description: Adds a public web page to the artist's vault as a suggested Lore source, for any signed-in user. A URL already in the vault, with or without its fragment, is refused.

get.description: Downloads the artist's Lore document as one self-contained Markdown file: a dated header, the document with its `[n]` citation markers, and the numbered sources it cites. `format=csv` returns the sources as a CSV table instead. Only the artist's approved claimant or an admin may export it.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the source table. Anything else, or nothing, for the Markdown document.

200.description: The file, as an attachment named `<artist-slug>-<date>.md` or `<artist-slug>-sources-<date>.csv`.

Access-Control-Expose-Headers.description: `Content-Disposition`, so a cross-origin download can read the file name.
